swingContinuity: 최근 며칠간 QQQ 매수점수가 74~75 구간을 유지하다 9월28일(월, 뉴욕) 72로 소폭 하락했으나, 매도점수가 23으로 크게 개선되며 9월 26일(금, 뉴욕) 38 대비 긍정적 흐름을 보였습니다. 다만, 최근 5거래일 QQQ는 -0.80%로 마감하며 SOXX(+1.17%→-1.79%)와 TSLA(-1.54%→-2.53%)가 약세를 보인 가운데 NVDA(+0.22%→+3.01%)만 강세를 보인 종목 간 온도차를 나타냈습니다.
swingContinuityEn: QQQ's buy score, which had been maintained in the 74-75 range for the past few days, slightly decreased to 72 today. However, the sell score significantly improved to 23, showing a positive trend compared to 38 on September 26 (Fri, NY). Despite this, QQQ closed at -0.80% over the last 5 trading days, with a divergence among stocks: SOXX (+1.17%→-1.79%) and TSLA (-1.54%→-2.53%) showed weakness, while NVDA (+0.22%→+3.01%) was strong.
